sections.bio: I am a certified LinkedIn content creator, recruiter, and job board owner focused on connecting professionals with career opportunities. I create videos, social media content, and newsletters that engage job seekers, recruiters, and industry leaders. I manage two newsletters with a combined 10,000+ subscribers and a LinkedIn audience of 27,000+ followers. More than 40% of my audience consists of decision-makers, creating a strong platform for meaningful engagement, partnerships, and industry conversations.
